\section{Strains that already exist\secstatus{todo}}\label{sec:exists}

Twelve singles and thirteen doubles were built and measured in run 4. No triple
has been constructed in any round.

\input{tables/t1-existing-singles}

\notesec{Eleven of the twelve singles carry a prediction, not twelve}
The panel the interaction predictions were made over holds \gene{YIL174W}, which
has not been built, and does not hold SPH1 (\gene{YLR313C}), which has. So of the
twelve singles in Table~\ref{tab:existing-singles}, eleven are panel genes with a
prediction attached and one is not, and every triple in this build list is drawn
from those eleven.

One of the eleven is itself unsettled. \gene{YLR312C-B} (\texttt{s12}) is an SGD
\emph{ORF, Merged} feature with no discrete protein, it carries zero trigenic
training records, and SPH1 was the recommended replacement for it, a swap that has
not been made. It is in six of the twenty triples. Setting it aside would leave ten
usable panel genes and would change those six, so the decision is worth making
before the crosses start rather than after.

\notesec{SPH1 is an open question}
\texttt{s11}, SPH1 (\gene{YLR313C}), is in none of the twenty triples in
Table~\ref{tab:new-triples}, at a measured fitness of 1.0882
(Table~\ref{tab:existing-singles}). It can ride along on the measurement plate as a
near-wild-type control, or it can be dropped. If it rides along, the plate carries
71 strains rather than 70, at the same five wells each.

\input{tables/t2-existing-doubles}

All thirteen doubles go on the measurement plate. The pairs marked
\texttt{yes} under \emph{parent} are the starting strains for
Table~\ref{tab:new-triples}; the rest are re-measured alongside them, which gives
a second reading on each of those pairs.

\notesec{One designed double failed to construct: no colonies after
transformation}
\gene{YJR060W} $\times$ \gene{YKL033W-A} was designed into run 4 and is the one
pair of the fourteen that did not come through: the transformation gave zero
colonies. No attempt date was recorded and no retry is on record. Both parent
singles exist and were measured. The pair is not part of the build list, and nothing in
Tables~\ref{tab:new-doubles} or~\ref{tab:new-triples} depends on it.
